property_summary: After any sendMoney call, the depositsCount must equal the number of times the fallback has been triggered plus the number of successful sendMoney calls that sent value, but the buggy version ignores failure of the external call, making depositsCount inconsistent with actual value transfers.
change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks the result of the low-level call, allowing sendMoney to succeed silently even when the external call fails.
